title: Moby's new video
content: Here's a new music video called "Are You Lost In The World Like Me?" byMoby & The Void Pacific Choirwith animation bySteve Cuttsin a 30's retro style. The subject is a little depressing—how people are all hooked on their devices—but it's incisive satire, an apt commentary on our times.(Link to see the video on YouTube)
